verdict.rationale: First-party docs say the SDK is built to run untrusted code securely in isolated environments, with each sandbox in its own VM or container and a full Linux environment. They position it explicitly for AI agents that execute code. Supporting controls include Worker-based interception of outbound HTTP, session command timeouts, and stdin input that avoids shell injection. Community comments question how fine-grained egress control is and how resource limits work, but neither contradicts the isolation claim. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of the isolation boundary, documented per-sandbox resource limits, clearer fine-grained egress policy controls.
